about_the_game:
The world has flooded. Only a collection of islands remain, trading and travelling amongst each other to form a semi-stable society. Vera (renamable) finds herself on the docks of Vadena, an island of winding canals and opulent wealth, after a savage attack on her ship that nearly ends her life. Her near-death experience has left Vera with some gaps in her memory, and she roams the island in search of clues of what brought her to its shores. 

Vera quickly realizes that she has been cursed to repeat a single day. Unsure of who has done this to her - and why - she sets out to investigate Vadena.

'Day After Day' showcases a skill system with fifteen unique abilities within three categories to allow for different playstyles and roleplaying options. Active and passive skill roles can sway the narrative in unforeseen directions.

Gain experience points and level-up your skills by progressing the main quest line and solving side quests. Determine whether to solve tasks by helping or by causing harm to Vadena's residents. Uncover how your choices affect your surroundings in a single day and decide which course of action should become history on the final day of Vera's curse.

Jump from location to location using the 'Map' feature and unlock new destinations as you learn more about Vadena and converse with its residents. Click on the various characters and scenery incorporated in the art to start conversations, pick up items, and gain new insight.

Two men are pining for Vera's heart. The choice is yours.

Balazar: A notorious pirate who appears hellbent on keeping his past a secret while changing your relationship from enemies to lovers.

Enzo: A nobleman with a kind heart determined to win his father's dukedom and change Vadena for the better.

  • Female bounty hunter protagonist with customization options for hair and clothing

  • Countless dialogue options to allow for greater immersion

  • A full cast of 10+ characters that move from place to place based on time of day

  • Two different ways to break Vera's curse

  • Lore-heavy fantasy world with royalty, pirates, and magic

More to come as development continues. Demo will be released for Otome Jam 2025.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains descriptions of bodily injury, violent threats, strong language, and sexual innuendo.

short_description: Making mayhem, claiming valuables, and breaking hearts may be a full day's work, but the day keeps repeating and you have no idea why. Build your skillset, break your curse, and befriend or betray townspeople in this otome narrative RPG.
